## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/elevenlabs/text_to_speech/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['map OpenAI TTS parameters to ElevenLabs TTS parameters including voice, format, and speed', 'build the ElevenLabs TTS request payload from input text, model, and optional parameters', 'construct the ElevenLabs text-to-speech endpoint URL with voice ID and query parameters', 'validate ElevenLabs API key and set up authentication headers for the TTS request', 'wrap the ElevenLabs binary audio response into an HttpxBinaryResponseContent object']
```

Usage

```
{'map_openai_params': 'map OpenAI TTS parameters to ElevenLabs TTS parameters including voice, format, and speed', 'transform_text_to_speech_request': 'build the ElevenLabs TTS request payload from input text, model, and optional parameters', 'get_complete_url': 'construct the ElevenLabs text-to-speech endpoint URL with voice ID and query parameters', 'validate_environment': 'validate ElevenLabs API key and set up authentication headers for the TTS request', 'transform_text_to_speech_response': 'wrap the ElevenLabs binary audio response into an HttpxBinaryResponseContent object'}
```
